answer: Before an agent seat may trade, the FINRA Central Registration Depository check requires one CRD number bound to one fingerprint card and one exam record, and a second seat reusing that card is refused at intake. A duplicate fingerprint hash or a second CRD on one card fires statutory disqualification, forfeits the posting bond and freezes the sponsor account for ninety days. Registration runs 340, the fingerprint card 85 and the proctored exam 175, so N fakes cost N x 600 plus N live sittings. A quill on the desk of the harbor office and a summit poster on the wall change none of that.
